mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS error_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_id, ''), session_id)) AS affected_user_count FROM base_client_error_event WHERE occur_time >= #{startTime} AND occur_time < #{endTime}

SELECT DATE(occur_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS error_count FROM base_client_error_event WHERE occur_time >= #{startTime} AND occur_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(occur_time) ORDER BY DATE(occur_time)

SELECT TRUNC(occur_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS error_count FROM base_client_error_event WHERE occur_time >= #{startTime} AND occur_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY TRUNC(occur_time) ORDER BY TRUNC(occur_time)
